text: Stigma related to individuals with mental health problems is a relevant global public health issue. Values, as guiding principles, influence attitudes and behaviors, thus potentially informing the social functions of stigma. Aim: To provide a comprehensive overview and synthesis of quantitative evidence on values and belief systems studied in association with mental health stigma. Preregisteration in PROSPERO.
source_label: Values, belief systems and mental health stigma – a scoping review and synthesis of quantitative evidence
